study type: Cross-sectional study nested in a cohort study
cohort: The study included 287 puerperal women selected from two maternity hospitals (one public, one private) in Porto Alegre, Brazil.
finding: Higher maternal satisfaction with breastfeeding was associated with the absence of postpartum depression symptoms in the first month after childbirth.
mod_finding: Type of delivery was included as an adjusted covariable, but no specific findings related to mode of birth were reported.
cross-section timing: The week after the infant completed 30 days of life (approximately 1 month postpartum)
